searchText: there's a bit of a selection bias there though, I don't think attendees would be going in the same kinds of places that people usually end up being murdered or being involved in local organized crime Murder rate in a country is usually not evenly distributed. Chances of getting murdered in Detroit are wildly different from chances of getting murdered in Beverly Hills. Howdy, does anyone by chance know if there is an easy way to see the txs fees received by a validator for proposing a block? i.e. is there an endpoint for this? Bogota is safer than many american cities You know America isn’t a great example 😅 I mean I figured rich tourists to another country would be prime targets 😂 especially given many will be drinking or checking out the nightlife. That’s per 100,000 😅 I looked at homicide rate and it's 9.6 per 100k in bogota The Houston TX murder/homicide rate for 2018 was 11.77 per 100,000 population, a 2.35% increase from 2017. well that's slightly obsolete but shouldn't change that much but it's true that foreigners can be either much safer or at significantly higher risk to natives depending on local policies dunno where bogota lies here US has around 100k armed robberies a year total. Bogota has 80k+ armed robberies per 100,000 annually if I’m reading what I posted accurately. uhhh pretty sure that's a graph of total robberies lol imagine an 80% chance of getting robbed by armed thugs Yeah that seemed pretty bad 😂😂😂 That would still be around 40x more than the us though if bogota has 7 mil people. Maybe I am missing something, but I fail to see what this has to do with Ethereum? Is Ethereum going full ESG now? People are arguing about whether Bogota is such a dangerous place that it is a unreasonable to expect people to go there for Devcon.
